description: A Java class implementing a builder pattern for creating immutable Feature objects from existing features, with fluent API methods for setting properties, definition, and ID.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureFromCopyBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class with a fluent API for constructing immutable Feature instances based on an existing feature.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with properties from an existing Feature object.

methods.name: definition
methods.description: Sets the FeatureDefinition for the builder.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Sets the FeatureProperties for the builder.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Sets the FeatureProperties from a JsonObject, converting if necessary.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Transforms existing properties using a provided function.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the feature ID conditionally based on a predicate.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable Feature instance.
